recipe.formulationConcept: Protein class agent intended for population-level metabolic control at the lowest achievable burden of harm; formulation strategy must be selected by a qualified team from the required properties below, not inferred from this record.
recipe.conceptualSynthesisRoute: CONCEPTUAL ONLY: route selection is left to a qualified synthetic chemistry team working under institutional oversight. This record intentionally contains no step-level procedure, no reagent quantities, and no operational parameters.
requiredProperties: Retained potency at the mechanism targets above (reference: the pinned ChEMBL medians for CHEMBL4084119).
Adverse-event profile at or below the reference across every preregistered LOWER-HARM safety category.
Exposure characteristics compatible with the dosing interval studied in the contributing trials.
Manufacturability at national-programme scale — UNVERIFIED in this run.
